name: project-s
description: Engine-neutral game foundation: modules, schemas, bundles and traces.

scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:types && npm run test:unit && npm run test:traces
scripts.test:types: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.portable.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json
scripts.test:unit: node --test "tools/**/*.test.ts" "hosts/**/*.test.ts" "modules/**/*.test.ts" "examples/**/*.test.ts" && node hosts/python/run.ts -m unittest discover -s hosts/python -p "test_*.py"
scripts.test:traces: node tools/repo/cli.ts traces --host node --host python --root . --root examples --root hosts/conformance && node hosts/js/conformance.ts build/traces/node build/examples/traces/node build/hosts/conformance/traces/node hosts/js/test/golden/format-1 && node hosts/python/run.ts hosts/python/conformance.py build/traces/python build/examples/traces/python build/hosts/conformance/traces/python hosts/python/test/golden/format-1
